basic_info.description: 1142-1146 Montgomery Street presents a rare opportunity to acquire a 6-unit apartment building with significant upside potential in the highly coveted Telegraph Hill neighborhood of San Francisco. Built in 1907, this property boasts six spacious 1-bedroom/1-bathroom units, a large 5-car garage, and a prime location steps from the vibrant  Jackson Square and Financial District. With three recently remodeled units, upgraded electrical service, and a  strengthened foundation, the property offers immediate cash flow and a solid foundation for future value creation. The potential to add a roof deck with stunning views and develop a tenant amenity space on the rear parcel with mesmerizing Bay Bridge vistas further enhances the investment appeal. Offered at a 5.2% cap rate, 1142-1146 Montgomery Street is a compelling investment opportunity for those seeking a blend of current income and future value appreciation in one of San Francisco's most desirable locations.
